defects.title: Default daily brief prompt does not enforce canonical CoS format
defects.description: A plain daily-brief request should produce RB's canonical Chief-of-Staff briefing by default. The observed response led with market/industry strategy and company watchlist commentary, only lightly touching relationship intelligence. This recreates the earlier 'news briefing versus CoS briefing' failure mode after the system can already produce better CoS output when explicitly prompted.
defects.recommendation: Harden the Custom GPT prompt and/or API response contract so getDailyBrief is always rendered in canonical order: relationship signals and freshness, top priorities, recommended actions, what to ignore, loops/reconciliations, network/relationship implications, then subordinate industry intelligence. Do not require the user to say 'CoS-level' explicitly.

defects.title: Default brief did not visibly use grounding labels
defects.description: The observed default briefing did not label major priorities as system_detected, inferred, manual_user_provided, or stale_source_limited, despite the updated API/prompt contract requiring these labels for CoS brief output.
defects.recommendation: Ensure the Custom GPT instruction says any daily brief request, including 'show me my daily briefing', must use grounding labels. Consider making grounding labels part of the API-rendered daily brief text so the interface cannot omit them.

raw_text: User provided the full default daily briefing output in chat on 2026-05-19. The response opened with Top Strategic Signals around restaurant tech shifting from AI features to operational AI, the National Restaurant Show, PAR/NCR/Toast/Global Payments watchlist, Ish Singh/Maho relationship intelligence, macro trade/cost pressure, and Chief-of-Staff Style Recommendations. User pushed back: shouldn't CoS-level briefing be canonical by default? Codex assessment: yes, this is a default-behavior regression.
